summary: Health effects associated with exposure to radiofrequency electromagnetic fields include brain tumours, headaches, nausea, depression, sleep difficulties, concentration problems, memory loss, tinnitus, and other health issues. The text cites scientific evidence showing that long-term low-level RF radiation can cause adverse health effects, particularly among children and young adults. brief
